item.tib: bka' gsang mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud gu ru'i thugs bcud las yi dam gu ru drag po'i sngags zlog las kyi kha tshar
item.coloph: zlog pa mtshon cha 'khor lo'i rgyud las che mchog yi dam sngags zlog las kyi kha tshar mkha' spyod pa'i sngags 'chang gar dbang byang chub rdo rje rtsal gyis sbyar ba'o//
